name: Spectrum tunnel
description: The spectrum ring repeated down a tunnel and flown through — radial bars with floating peak caps at twenty depths, the nearest sweeping past the corners of the frame and the furthest converging on a stirred core. The frequency axis is mirrored across each ring, so the low end pumps on one axis and the top end glitters at right angles to it.

bars.description: Radial bars around each ring. High counts read as a corona; low counts as an instrument.

rings.description: How far down the tunnel the stack reaches.

inner.description: Radius of the ring in world units. Also sets how wide a bar is — they are spaced at the root, so a bigger ring gives fatter bars.

speed.description: How fast the rings come at the camera. 0 holds the stack still.

spin.description: Rotation in radians per second. The bands turn with the ring, so this is the whole instrument revolving rather than the spectrum sliding around a fixed dial.

twist.description: Per-ring rotation offset. Turns the stack into a corkscrew.

drift.description: How far the tunnel axis wanders off the middle of the frame.

core.description: Light down the throat everything converges on.

detail.description: Per-bar deviation from the six-point curve, scaled by onset.
